title: The tree-complement ensnaring conjecture
statement:
Let $T$ be an $m$-vertex tree, and let $n>m$ be an even integer. Using the $n$-vertex complement notation $\operatorname{compl}_n(T)$, **tree-complement ensnaring conjecture.** The graph $\operatorname{compl}_n(T)$ is ensnaring if and only if $m$ is odd.

This is a concrete problem toward understanding ensnaring graphs and dense graphs. It gives a proposed parity criterion for complements of trees, and the paper presents it as an unresolved question.
source_name: Colin Defant and Derek Liu, “Homology in Combinatorial Refraction Billiards”, arXiv:2502.06013 (2025).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.06013

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of February 2025).
